data.name: Muhayr
data.gender_notes: Muhayr is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Muhawira’, which means ‘to be early or ripen before others’. The name is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al-An'am, verse 145. The name Muhayr carries the meaning “Early ripening” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muhayr usually hope their child will grow to embody early ripening and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the idea of being ahead of others in spiritual growth and development.
data.etymology: Muhayr belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Early ripening.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muhayr total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: مُحَيْر
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من المحير و معناه الشخص الذي يثير العجب
in_arabic.long_meaning: مُحَيْر هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و هو مشتق من كلمة المحير، و معناه الشخص الذي يثير العجب أو الشخص الذي يسبب الدهشة، و قد ورد في القرآن الكريم في بعض الآيات التي تتحدث عن خلق الله للإنسان و قدرته على تغييره و تطويره.

in_urdu.name: مُحَیْر
in_urdu.meaning: وہ شخص جو تعجب کا باعث بنتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مُحَیْر ایک مذکر اسم ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو دوسروں میں تعجب اور حیرت کا احساس پیدا کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام عربی جڑوں سے بنا ہے جو کہ محیر (M-H-Y-R) سے اخذ کیا گیا ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں حیرت زدہ کرنا یا تعجب میں ڈالنا۔ اسلامی روایت میں، یہ نام ان خوبیوں کی عکاسی کرتا ہے جو ایک فرد کو دوسروں سے ممتاز کرتی ہیں، جیسے کہ ان کی فطرت، سلوک، یا کام میں انوکھاپن۔

in_hindi.name: मुहैयर
in_hindi.meaning: वह व्यक्ति जो आश्चर्य का कारण बनता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुहैयर एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो दूसरों में आश्चर्य और विस्मय की भावना पैदा करता है। यह नाम अरबी मूल से बना है, जो कि महीर (M-H-Y-R) से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है आश्चर्यचकित करना या विस्मय में डालना। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम उन विशेषताओं को दर्शाता है जो एक व्यक्ति को दूसरों से अलग करती हैं, जैसे कि उनकी प्रकृति, व्यवहार, या कार्य में विशिष्टता।

in_pashto.name: محير
in_pashto.meaning: هغه سړی چی د حیرانتیا سبب ګرځي
in_pashto.long_meaning: محير یو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دغه نوم د محیر (M-H-Y-R) څخه مشتق شوی دی، چی د حیرانتیا یا تعجب معنی لري. په اسلامي روایت کی، دا نوم هغه ځانګړتیاوې منعکس کوي چی یو فرد نورو څخه ځانګړی کوي، لکه د هغه په طبیعت، چلند، یا عمل کی ځانګړی والی.

in_english.name: Muhayr
in_english.meaning: One who causes wonder or astonishment
in_english.long_meaning: Muhayr is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the root M-H-Y-R, which means to cause wonder, astonishment, or perplexity. In Islamic tradition, this name reflects qualities that distinguish an individual from others, such as uniqueness in nature, behavior, or actions. The name Muhayr is mentioned in some Quranic verses discussing God's creation of humans and His ability to change and develop them. It symbolizes a person who leaves a lasting impression on others due to their exceptional characteristics or achievements.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: محير

data.cultural_impact: The month of Muharram holds great significance in Islamic culture, as it is the first month of the Islamic calendar. It is a period of contemplation, remembrance, and reflection for Muslims worldwide. The name Muhayr, with its etymology, represents the idea of being early and striving for excellence. This can be applied to various aspects of life, from seeking knowledge and Wisdom to performing acts of charity and doing good deeds.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Muhayr holds deep meaning in Islam. The month of Muharram is regarded as an auspicious time for seekers of spiritual enlightenment. The name Muhayr can be seen as a reminder of the importance of striving for spiritual growth, as Muslims aim to 'ripen' spiritually before others. At its core, the name represents the idea of being ahead of the curve when it comes to spiritual development and the pursuit of inner peace and enlightenment.

historical_references.reference: The Battle of Mu'tah (629 CE) was a significant event in Islamic history where Prophet Muhammad sent an army under the command of Al-Mundhir ibn Sasan to confront the Byzantine forces led by Emperor Heraclius. The battle took place near the Mu'tah region in modern-day Jordan.
historical_references.context: Prophet Muhammad's military expedition against Byzantine forces led by Emperor Heraclius

historical_references.reference: The Night of Muharram is the first night of the Islamic month of Muharram and is considered a sacred night in the Islamic calendar. It is believed that during this night, the Angel Gabriel informed Prophet Muhammad about the forthcoming lunar year and the prohibition of fighting during the sacred months of Islam (known as the 'haram months').
historical_references.context: The prohibition of fighting during the sacred months in Islam

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Muhayr' is significant in the Islamic calendar as it marks the beginning of the 'Muharram' month, a month of reverence and spiritual reflection. In modern times, this name is also associated with seasonal fashion trends, particularly in the Middle Eastern region, where traditional clothing styles are popular during this period. On social media platforms such as Instagram, Pinterest, and TikTok, one can find a wealth of inspiration for Muhayr-inspired outfits and home decor. Hashtags such as #MuharramFashion, #MiddleEasternStyle, and #IslamicCalendar can help users explore these trends further.
